brief.headline: Lock in ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps at higher volume and qualify Manjushree as second source

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on 28 mm caps at higher volumes or looser specs
priceAsk.basis: The open market for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The market view is 'modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec', so that lower band is our target — achievable if we commit volume or relax tolerance

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt; no reason to tighten

brief.financialLeverage: Empire Industries publishes no financials, so we don't know their revenue, profit or how tight cash is for them. Our ₹67.47 L annual spend is meaningful but not decisive leverage on its own. We're building our asks on the open-market price bands and on having credible second sources lined up. Without their financial picture, the plan is to benchmark hard to the market and show we can move volume elsewhere if needed.

evidence.point: Market asking price for 28 mm induction-wad PP cap
Market verdict: modest headroom to lower band at higher volume or looser spec
HDPE resin import reference (raw material benchmark)
We already pay them 30 Days After Receipt; no need to squeeze payment

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B 65/100). Top second-source candidate; worth an RFQ now

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, pharma (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100). Strong, profitable — a robust backup for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — manufacturer with pan-India reach; medium confidence

risks: Empire Industries' financials aren't public, so we're flying blind on their stability — line up Manjushree and get pricing before we push hard
The market 'modest headroom' to ₹0.65–0.80 assumes we commit higher volume or accept looser specs — make sure operations can live with that trade before we ask
Our ₹67.47 L spend may not be big enough to dictate terms alone — the alternates are our real leverage; show Empire we're serious about qualifying a second source
Market backups like Reliance and Srichakra Polyplast are leads only (medium confidence) — don't threaten to switch to them until we've verified they can supply caps at pharma grade
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're seeing 28 mm caps quoted at ₹0.65–0.80 in the market at higher volumes, and we're qualifying Manjushree as a second source — let's talk about how we get to that price band with you.
